overview.description: The Horizon Flexible Income ETF (FLXN) is an exchange-traded fund that mostly invests in high yield fixed income. The fund is actively managed, investing in high-yield fixed-income securities and adjusting exposures based on market and economic trends through income-producing assets, tactical credit shifts, and put spread overlays. This approach aims to deliver current income and pursue total return with risk-aware credit exposure. FLXN was launched on Jul 2, 2025 and is issued by Horizon.
